cards.example_en: We ran out of petrol halfway to the countryside.
cards.example_zh: 去乡下走到半路，我们的汽油用完了。

cards.example_en: The building is now in the final phase of repair.
cards.example_zh: 这栋楼的修缮现在到了最后阶段。

cards.example_en: Because of rain, our match moved onto the indoor pitch.
cards.example_zh: 因为下雨，我们的比赛改到了室内球场。

cards.example_en: Seat belts prevent serious injury on the school bus.
cards.example_zh: 安全带可以防止校车上发生严重伤害。

cards.example_en: The corner shop raised the price of milk again.
cards.example_zh: 街角小店又把牛奶的价格提高了。

cards.example_en: Making paper turned out to be a slow process in art club.
cards.example_zh: 在美术社团里，造纸成了一个缓慢的过程。

cards.example_en: This soap is a product of the village workshop.
cards.example_zh: 这种肥皂是村里作坊的产物。

cards.example_en: This job offers a good career prospect.
cards.example_zh: 这份工作有很好的职业前景。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：公共的
cards.example_en: The public library stays open until eight in the evening.
cards.example_zh: 公共图书馆开放到晚上八点。

cards.example_en: This bread is better quality than yesterday's loaf.
cards.example_zh: 这面包的质量比昨天那条更好。

cards.example_en: Could you repeat the address so I can write it?
cards.example_zh: 你能把地址再重复一遍，好让我写下来吗？

cards.example_en: Helping at the fair earned him a reward of free tickets.
cards.example_zh: 他在集市上帮忙，得到的报酬是几张免费票。

cards.example_en: The ball may roll under the sofa during the game.
cards.example_zh: 游戏进行时，球可能会滚到沙发底下。

cards.example_en: The winter book sale drew a long queue outside.
cards.example_zh: 冬季图书特卖让门外排起了长队。

cards.example_en: I scan the menu before I order lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我点午餐之前先扫读一遍菜单。
